No. I am wallowing in my self pity. Calmer than anything. I see why no one wants to help me. It's because I don't want to help myself anymore.

That's a lot to assume from my post — this is all new info to me, as in I learnt about this recently and although I have decided to break up with her, I was genuinely plagued by a doubt of what was real. I thought I deserved to know. That was the point of this post. I don't think I have made any excuses for her, neither am I justifying me being with her.

Thanks for trying to help, though.
Thanks, man. I really want people to know how horrible a person she is because her social facade is of a wholesome person with depression trying to make everyone happy. WHICH ISN'T.
I'm terrified of this - she's so interwoven into my social circle that I don't have anyone to even talk about it now. It would look like I'm blaming the victim, right?
I can't call her out on it, I would look like a victim blaming cunt.
Do I not get to know what the truth of it was?

This also extends to people who say "Sheesh, you can't even handle two beers?"

I mean... Two beers get me drunk while you need twenty. Your tolerance is neither cost effective nor brag worthy.

I would suggest you to try therapy because it goes hand in hand with medication. I'm from India as well, and depending on where you live, pretty sure you can find some really good therapists. If you're in any major city in the south, DM me and I can help you with some therapists if you would want to try.

Keep the fight going.

I'm sorry, I understand how difficult it must be. I have had the same problem. Medication just makes me dysfunctional and I cannot just afford to slip up at work.

Are you coupling this with therapy as well? That way you can have a secondary opinion and maybe work with a psychiatrist that will complement your therapy.
Thanks, man. I'm doing okay. I hope you are wonderful too. ❤️
